verses.text: Yakb'an unin animaexto, naekkot Dios he b'oumal, yakb'an mantzak eyab' sya'il yuj icham animail. Yujto ay jun pekti' ol eyal icha tik: Manhxa swach'il kajek' skab'i, xe chama.
Naekkot Dios chi' tiknaik yakb'an tzato yal eyilan yok k'u, yok k'e'en uj yet' yok k'e'en k'anal, yik mantzak syamoch ste jawi ya'elal t'ayex.
Yujto ay jun k'ual a he k'ab' tzex kolan tiknaik, toxonhej ol luklonok, haxo eyok te tek'an, ol el yip. Manhxapaxlaj k'e'en eye b'aj ol yal he kach'an he wa'el, ol ixtaxpax yol he sat.

Ayik ol jawok jun pekti' chi' t'a eyib'anh, manhxo ol yal-laj eyab'an tastak sk'anh t'a yoltak b'e, manhxo ol eyab'paxlaj sk'anh k'e'en cha'. Pitzan ex xo ayik tz'ok' nok' much ayik ayto sk'ana', manhxo ol eyab' yoch b'it t'a he tz'ey.

Ol ex xiw he k'e t'a junok cha'anh, ayxo smay eyek' t'a yoltak b'e. Ol syamoch sakb'i xil he jolom, tewelxonhej ol ex ek' machaljok, manhxa pax tas ol he na' t'a eyetb'eyum, yujto wanxo he b'atkan t'a he kajnub' t'a kampusante t'a junelnhej. Ha heb' anima t'a yoltak b'e, ol laj ok' heb' yuj he chamel.

Ko naekkot jun Dios onh b'o'ani, yujto ay jun k'ual ol lajwokk'och ko k 'inal, icha junok candil nab'a oro spoji ayik st'inhchaj skatenail nab'a plata b'aj chinank'ei. Mato icha tz'aj spojb'at lum ch'ub' t'a sti' ha ha', ma icha tz'aj spoj k'e'en tzek' surson b'aj stok'jik'eta ha ha' t'a yol jul.
Ayik slajwik'och ko niwanil tik, smeltzajxikanoch pokokal t'a sat lum tik, ichataxon yaj t'a yalanhtaxo. Haxo ko pixan sk'exkan t'a Dios, yujto ha' ak'jinakoch t'ayonh.
Ha in alum in el lolonel tik swalanxi junelxo: Masanil juntzanh tik, malaj sjolomal yaji, malaj yelk'ochi.

Ha wal yuj in jelanil, manh jantakok tas wach' ix wak' yojtakejel heb' wetanimail. Hanhejtona' jantak pax juntzanh lolonel ix in sik'kani, ix lajwi chi' ix in ch'olb'itaneli, ix wak'anoch t'a stzolal.
Ix in say wal lolonel to wach'nhej scha'an sb'a to yel, yik tzin tz'ib'ejkan icha wal smojal.

Ha tastak syal heb' jelan, lajan wal icha junok teklab' jay snhi' stekjioch t'a nok' wakax, haxo yik toxo ix molchaj juntzanh lolonel chi', lajan wal icha te' estaca tzatz yaj smak'chajemi. Ha juntzanh lolonel chi' ha Dios Kilumal, ha' ix ak'an t'ayonh.
Ex unin anima, scham wal heyilani, manh komonok tzeyak'och he b'a t'a junokxo komon lolonel, yujto a tz'ib'oj u'um malaj slajwub', hanhejtona' tato te ay tas sko k'ayb'ej t'ay, tzonh tzaktzajk'e yuj.
Icha tik tz'aj slajwikan juntzanh lolonel tik. Ix alchajkan smasanil. Ayokab' yelk'och Dios t'ayonh, ko k'anab'ajejek masanil scheknab'il, yujto a jun chi' yowalil sko k'ulej.
Yujto ha Dios ol ch'olb'itan masanil tastak sko k'ulej, tato wach', mato chuklaj, wach'chom elk'altak ix laj ko k'ulej.
